governance_boundary.consensus_principle: Both validator answers must be identical on three consensus fields: fulfilment_band must be exactly the same discrete value, customs_cleared must be exactly the same boolean, and temp_breached must be exactly the same boolean. peak_temp_celsius must agree within 0.5 C and transit_hours within 0.05 h. If either answer is missing a field, or if one answer failed to bind the bill of lading, the answers are not equivalent.
settlement_paths: reclaim_expired_shipment (shipper only, after missed deadline, no manifest)
